summary: In March 2022, the now defunct Colombian airline Viva Air suffered a data breach and subsequent ransomware attack. title: Dymocks: 836.1K accounts breached
summary: In September 2023, the Australian book retailer Dymocks announced a data breach. The data dated back to June 2023 and contained 1.2M records with 836k unique email addresses. The breach also exposed names, dates of birth, genders, phone numbers and physical addresses.
